# cloptima_llm_dataset (Resource)

Manages a prompt evaluation dataset. The dataset is a snapshot of up to 1000 recent LLM requests captured when it is created; its records do not change afterwards. Changing name, description, or app_id creates a new dataset.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloptima_llm_dataset" "support_evals" {
  name        = "support-agent-evals"
  description = "Snapshot of recent support agent requests used to evaluate prompt releases"
  app_id      = "customer-support-app"
  is_golden   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Dataset name.

### Optional

- `app_id` (String) Captures only requests from this application ID.
- `description` (String) Dataset purpose and contents.
- `is_golden` (Boolean) Whether this dataset is marked as a golden dataset for evaluations. Defaults to false.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) Dataset ID.
- `record_count` (Number) Number of records in this dataset.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
